claims.statement: The tales later spread to the West Indies, Suriname, Sierra Leone (where they were introduced by Jamaican Maroons) and the Netherlands Antilles.
claims.statement_id: Kisah-kisah itu kemudian menyebar ke Hindia Barat, Suriname, Sierra Leone (dibawa oleh Maroon Jamaika), dan Antilla Belanda.
claims.quote: They later spread to the West Indies, Suriname, Sierra Leone (where they were introduced by Jamaican Maroons) and the Netherlands Antilles

claims.statement: In several folktales Anansi has a family: his long-suffering wife Okonore Yaa (known elsewhere as Aso, Crooky or Shi Maria) and his sons Ntikuma the firstborn, Tikelenkelen the big-headed, Nankonhwea with a spindly neck and legs, and Afudohwedohwe the pot-bellied.
claims.statement_id: Dalam beberapa kisah Anansi memiliki keluarga: istrinya yang sabar, Okonore Yaa (di daerah lain dikenal sebagai Aso, Crooky, atau Shi Maria), dan putra-putranya Ntikuma si sulung, Tikelenkelen si berkepala besar, Nankonhwea yang berleher dan berkaki kurus, serta Afudohwedohwe si perut buncit.
claims.quote: Anansi also has a family in several folktales involving him, consisting of his long-suffering wife Okonore Yaa - known in other regions as Aso, Crooky, or Shi Maria; Ntikuma, his firstborn son; Tikelenkelen, his big-headed son; Nankonhwea, his son with a spindly neck and spindly legs; finally, Afudohwedohwe, his pot-bellied son.

claims.statement: Anansi stories were part of an exclusively oral tradition, and Anansi himself was seen as synonymous with skill and wisdom in speech.
claims.statement_id: Kisah Anansi merupakan bagian dari tradisi yang sepenuhnya lisan, dan Anansi sendiri dipandang identik dengan keterampilan dan kebijaksanaan berbicara.
claims.quote: Anansi stories were part of an exclusively oral tradition, and Anansi himself was seen as synonymous with skill and wisdom in speech.

claims.statement: Anansi was often celebrated as a symbol of slave resistance and survival, because he is able to turn the tables on his powerful oppressors through cunning and trickery.
claims.statement_id: Anansi sering dirayakan sebagai lambang perlawanan dan ketahanan budak, karena ia mampu membalikkan keadaan terhadap penindas yang berkuasa lewat kecerdikan dan tipu dayanya.
claims.quote: Anansi was often celebrated as a symbol of slave resistance and survival, because Anansi is able to turn the tables on his powerful oppressors by using his cunning and trickery

claims.statement: Anansi becomes both an ideal to aspire toward and a cautionary tale against the selfish desires that can cause our undoing.
claims.statement_id: Anansi menjadi sekaligus teladan yang dicita-citakan dan kisah peringatan terhadap keinginan egois yang dapat menjadi sebab kehancuran kita.
claims.quote: Anansi becomes both an ideal to be aspired toward, and a cautionary tale against the selfish desires that can cause our undoing.

claims.statement: Names for Anansi in different places include Kacou Ananzè (Côte d'Ivoire), Kwaku Ananse (Jamaica, Ghana), Bru Nansi (Virgin Islands), Anansi or Anancy (Jamaica, Grenada, Costa Rica, Colombia, Nicaragua), Anansi Drew (The Bahamas) and Aunt Nancy (South Carolina).
claims.statement_id: Nama-nama lain Anansi di berbagai daerah antara lain Kacou Ananzè (Pantai Gading), Kwaku Ananse (Jamaika, Ghana), Bru Nansi (Kepulauan Virgin), Anansi atau Anancy (Jamaika, Grenada, Kosta Rika, Kolombia, Nikaragua), Anansi Drew (Bahama), dan Aunt Nancy (Carolina Selatan).
claims.quote: Kacou Ananzè (Côte d'Ivoire) Kwaku Ananse (Jamaica), (Ghana) Bru Nansi (Virgin Islands) Anansi or Anancy (Jamaica, Grenada, Costa Rica, Colombia, Nicaragua) Anansi (Trinidad and Tobago, Turks and Caicos Islands) Anansi Drew (The Bahamas) Aunt Nancy (South Carolina)

claims.statement: Anansi's name comes from the word in the Akan language for "spider".
claims.statement_id: Nama Anansi berasal dari kata dalam bahasa Akan untuk "laba-laba".
claims.quote: Anansi's name comes from the word in the Akan language for "spider".

claims.statement: One story explains how he became known as the owner of all stories in the world.
claims.statement_id: Salah satu kisah menjelaskan bagaimana ia dikenal sebagai pemilik semua cerita di dunia.
claims.quote: one explains how he became known as the owner of all stories in the world.

claims.statement: In one version Anansi wanted to acquire the stories of the sky god Nyame, who held them all to himself; Nyame set him four challenges in exchange: capturing the python Onini, the hornets Mmoboro, the leopard Osebo and the dwarf Mmoatia.
claims.statement_id: Dalam satu versi, Anansi ingin mendapatkan cerita milik dewa langit Nyame, yang menyimpan semuanya sendiri; Nyame memberinya empat tantangan sebagai imbalan: menangkap ular piton Onini, tawon Mmoboro, macan tutul Osebo, dan kurcaci Mmoatia.
claims.quote: Anansi wanted to acquire the stories of the sky god Nyame, who held all the stories to himself. Nyame tasks Anansi with four challenges in exchange for them: the capture of the python Onini, the hornets known as Mmoboro, the leopard Osebo, and the dwarf Mmoatia.

claims.statement: In the Marvel Comics series The Amazing Spider-Man volume 2 (2003), Ezekiel Sims reveals that Kwaku Anansi was the first Spider-Man.
claims.statement_id: Dalam serial Marvel Comics The Amazing Spider-Man volume 2 (2003), terungkap oleh Ezekiel Sims bahwa Kwaku Anansi adalah Spider-Man pertama.
